0.content:
Draff is Diona's father and the head of Springvale's hunters: calm, skilled, a firm believer in sustainable hunting, and the man young Diona wanted to become. He is also a heavy drinker who becomes loud, boastful and forgetful after the hunt. Diona refuses to blame him; she blames the wine. She still says she adores him more than anyone and that if he did not drink, he would keep her company. Draff warns strangers away from his daughter, expects her to inherit his role as leader, and calls her bartending a rebellious phase he must wait out patiently. He brags that she is one of Mondstadt's top bartenders and admits she nags him constantly about drinking.

In her Hangout (1.5) he got drunk after a hunt and charged alone into Dadaupa Gorge to fetch samachurl herbal soup she had mentioned, boasting that a Kätzlein could go anywhere. Diona sneaked in with the Traveler, found him rambling about "hilihogs" and "hilihounds", sobered him up, and listed his past drunken exploits (chasing dogs, chugging spring water, begging Myweiss for a song about a hunter's loyal hilihound). One ending shows him keeping his promise to find the soup for her; she whispers "Thanks, Daddy" and then claims she said "don't drink so much".

In 5.6 he helped her shelter civilians at the Cat's Tail during the Durin crisis. In the 5.4 Anecdotes (limited) he caught a cold, and Diona nursed him and hunted with traps so he could rest. In 6.7 Barbeloth's advice to tell "the one who fills your heart the most" how she feels plainly points at him; Diona fears he never listens once he starts drinking.

1.content: Springvale grew up around a spring said to have been created by a fairy who saved a despairing mother and her sick son. Few believe the legend now. Little Diona did, and on nights when her father slept off his drink she talked to the moon reflected in the water. The fairy found those feelings worth answering and became her secret friend. On Diona's seventh birthday it blessed her ("May your cup always run over with the sweet wine of celebration") as a farewell, and never appeared again. Diona came to think it was a dream, and has not connected that dream with the fact that every drink she makes tastes wonderful.

2.comment: Diona: Reunion with the Spring Fairy (4.1)
2.content: During the limited-time 4.1 event Waterborne Poetry, Diona attended Liyue's Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala for the Cat's Tail and met a blue-haired Fontainian poet, Callirhoe. She turned out to be the fairy: an Oceanid who settled in Springvale after the death of Fontaine's previous Hydro Archon. She proved it by naming Diona's fish pillow, Bubbles. Diona fetched "Grandpa" Finch, the boy from the legend now grown old, so the two could meet before Callirhoe's form faded. Callirhoe called Diona one of her truest friends and said she gave her the gift so a part of her could always be with Diona; Diona only managed a puzzled "Huh?".

3.comment: Diona: The Cat's Tail and Margaret
3.content:
The Cat's Tail is a cat-filled tavern in Mondstadt City and a rival to Angel's Share; it is also the city's Genius Invokation TCG hangout. Its owner Margaret hired Diona because she was too cute to refuse, then watched business boom and the Dawn Winery's monopoly crack. Margaret made Diona a cocktail shaker decorated with a cat's tail as an induction gift. Diona looks after the tavern cats while calling them arrogant: Roger (loves toys and high places), Nelson (always hungry yet light), Paisley (ignores strangers and does as he pleases, but lets Diona carry him). Regulars call her "Little Diona" and ask her to meow, which she refuses.

In her Hangout she ran errands for the cats, ordered a durable toy from Marjorie and cat food from Sara at the Good Hunter, and admitted, depending on the Traveler's words, either that the cats draw more customers than her drinks or that her drinks pay for their food. During Weinlesefest Margaret gives her days off because the festival upsets her so much (3.1, limited).

4.content:
The Kätzlein are a Springvale family of renowned hunters, at least three hundred years old, marked by cat ears and tails that are very rare in Mondstadt. They are still human. Infiltration, archery, climbing and dodging come naturally to them; they see well in the dark and have sharp hearing and smell. Dr. Edith wrote about Diona in her notes "Studies Into Bloodlines Strange and Unfamiliar", adding that she bites when piqued. Members include Olaf (a hunter frozen in ice for three centuries and recently thawed), his distant descendant Draff, Diona, and the young Herne. Diona's claim that every Kätzlein gets a Vision is a fib: Draff has none.

Diona's namecard wonders whether the features were an ancient prank by "a certain someone". Sucrose has similar features but concluded through observation that hers come from a different ancestry. In 3.7 (limited) a nekomata courier from Inazuma mistook Diona for a youkai; Diona explained her bloodline and wondered aloud whether only youkai have tails there.

5.content: A storm once raged for three days while Draff was out hunting, and the Knights of Favonius search parties could make no headway. The dread of losing him outright, worse than any "sharing" with wine, drove Diona out into the tempest. Water in her path froze under a power she did not recognise: her Cryo Vision. She tracked her father to a broken gorge and brought him home with the other hunters, and smiled only when she knew he would be fine. Then she offered him a drink "to numb the pain", the first she ever mixed normally; he called it wonderful. She tells the Traveler the story reluctantly, and only because they are friends.

6.comment: Diona: Elzer, Connor and the Dawn Winery
6.content:
Diona considers the Dawn Winery the "final boss" of her crusade and the root of Mondstadt's drunkenness, and refuses to go anywhere linked to it, including Angel's Share. Elzer, who runs the winery's business, saw the Cat's Tail break the winery's monopoly overnight and tried to poach her. He praised her "passion and love for wine" over the bar; her hand began to tremble; later he told Diluc, bandaged, that he had been bitten by a cat.

In her Hangout (1.5) the winery's Connor ambushed her with a "chance meeting" and a well-rehearsed invitation to exchange mixing techniques at the winery, with Elzer as the "impartial" judge. Diona tried to learn proper technique so she could do everything wrong. The Traveler's sloppy copy was revolting; every version she touched herself came out exquisite, and the two men's flattery (drinking it "for the rest of your life") drove her to fury.

7.comment: Diona: Hangout - The Cat and the Cocktail
7.content: Diona's Hangout Event (1.5) has three branches. In the first she and the Traveler fetch the runaway tavern cats. In the second she wants samachurl herbal soup from Dadaupa Gorge as a drink base, learns from the hunter Allan that a drunk Draff has gone in alone, and sneaks through monster camps to rescue him; she sobers him with a concoction, either one she mixes (which he finds delicious) or one the Traveler mixes (which makes him vomit). In the third she collects lizard tails, butterfly dust, frog mucus, fish scales and slime condensate and is drawn into the Dawn Winery's mixing "exchange". Each ending reaffirms the same joke: her drinks cannot be bad, and the plan cannot work.

8.content: Diona's logic runs: no Diluc, no wine industry; no wine industry, Daddy wouldn't drink; Daddy not drinking, he would keep her company. The Dawn Winery existed long before Diluc or his father, but she blames him anyway. Diluc has noticed her rigid attitude, wondered if it was about his family line, and on learning she simply despises alcohol remarked that he never expected to meet another bartender like himself in Mondstadt. They have not had a real conversation in canon.

9.content: Klee thinks Diona is "the best", repeats her vow to destroy the wine industry and wants to help with bombs, without knowing what a wine industry is. Diona always takes Klee somewhere far from the tavern when they play, because alcohol and explosives are a dangerous combination: she wants the industry destroyed, "but not in that sense". In Weinlesefest (3.1, limited) Klee's half-told story made Diona think the Traveler was teaching Razor to drink; Klee apologised, offered fish and Dodoco to pet, and Diona instantly forgave her.

10.comment: Diona: Boozehounds of the Knights (Kaeya, Lisa, Eula, Jean)
10.content:
Diona sorts adults by whether they drink. Kaeya, the cavalry captain who "downs drink after drink" and laughs, is a disgusting boozehound; he teases that the Traveler is too young to share Diona's drinks and asks the Traveler not to tell her he enjoys a drink with cards. Lisa is kind and gentle, yet a regular drinker, which makes Diona despair for Mondstadt. Eula drinks too, but says the two get along surprisingly well as kindred spirits who both "infiltrated" their enemies. Jean is a rare mature adult who does not drink, though Diona thinks the Knights overdo protecting her.

In Kaeya's Hangout (3.8) Diona joined the choir songwriting session as his helper, checked whether they could really sing about "the evils of Mondstadt's wine industry", proposed the line "All boozehounds will be punished harshly by Lord Barbatos!" (Venti sneezed), then settled on praising her mom's Fish Head Soup.

11.content: When Genius Invokation TCG spread to Mondstadt (3.3), the Cat's Tail became its hub. Diona grumbled that players always drink and that "games and drinks don't mix", even plotting to stamp out the game, but she taught the Traveler to play using cards a customer had left on the bar ("not because I like to play the game or anything"). She later reminds them that she is the one who taught them, and they call her Coach. In 3.7 (limited) she was too busy to enter the Adventurers' Guild tournament.

12.content: When monsters spawned from the dead dragon Durin's remains overran Mondstadt City (5.6), Diona held the Cat's Tail as a safe house. She told Albedo and the Traveler to send anyone needing shelter to her, calling the monsters more annoying than boozehounds. She said that everyone calls this city home and sheltering people was the least she could do. Draff was there with her, holding the tavern when she went out to fetch another group.

13.content: During this limited-time event Diona went to Liyue as the Cat's Tail's mixologist at the Neighboring Nations Congenial Poetry Gala, hoping to wreck Mondstadt wine's reputation abroad. She hunted Jueyun Chilis for a drink, made Chongyun one (slime condensate, chili, frog legs; it worked on his pure-yang spirit and failed as sabotage), met the adeptus Xiao and found him shy, and answered riddles by blurting the first concrete thing she thought of. She recalled the Springvale legend of the fairy and the boy from her father. With Mika, Chongyun and the Traveler she found Callirhoe, fetched Old Finch for the reunion, and afterwards, in a good mood, agreed to mix drinks for Venti and the others.

14.content: In the limited-time Weinlesefest event Diona hid from the festival while Margaret gave her days off. Hearing a garbled story from Klee, she stormed in accusing the Traveler of corrupting Razor, her daddy's friend. Once she understood that Razor wanted to recreate his parents' wine to learn about them, and that nobody planned to drink it, she agreed to help just this once, warning that she mixes finished drinks rather than brewing them. Her touch worked. In the event's final scene she was seen keeping a bottle away from Draff in the city.

15.content: When Varka returned from Nod-Krai with part of the expeditionary force, the Cat's Tail was stop three of their tavern crawl. Sick of them, Diona tried to have the tavern cat Prince mix their drinks; the drunks provoked him and he scratched Varka on his way out. Diona finished the recipe herself: wood chips from knights' clothes, pigeon feathers and hilichurl herbal soup. Varka, believing it a magic recipe, gathered the same ingredients for his Witch's Homework and collapsed after one gulp, seeing visions of past Knights of Boreas. Diona, hiding in a bush from him, worried whether "the old boozebrain" would be okay. Varka then laughed that the missing ingredient was the spring fairy's blessing.

16.content: In 6.7 Diona went to Fontaine to find "completely inedible" ingredients, having decided that limiting herself to food was too narrow. Heinry, maker of Fonta at the Fontaine Research Institute, gave her free samples (he smells of Fonta, not alcohol, so she trusts him) and sent her to a fortune-teller near the Court of Fontaine. Barbeloth told her the "affliction" is like a shoot grown into the tree of her fate, which has nourished her all along; cutting it would harm the whole tree. Diona drew the reversed High Priestess ("too focused on the illusions before the veil") and was told her heart was stuck and that she should tell the person who fills it most how she truly feels. She denied any change, offered to pay the fee in full, promised Barbeloth a delicious drink in Mondstadt and was sent to Mona for an interpretation.

17.content: In the limited-time 5.4 Anecdotes, Diona hunts solo ("Kätzlein hunters return successful even when they go solo"), shouts "Pew-Pew" while shooting, and leaps onto the Traveler's back at a wolf's howl, then denies being scared (the anecdote's description says Kätzlein hunters have an inherited fear of wolves). She collects bones and odd samples for Sucrose's experiments. While Draff recovered from a cold she tried new mechanical traps; all her bait vanished, including Sucrose's experimental Calla Lilies, and the "culprit" was Razor, who thought the bait was gifts from Springvale and passed the lilies to Bennett. She swore never to use traps again: she hunts best with her bow.

18.comment: Diona: Durin and the Cat Sofa (6.2)
18.content: The reborn Durin, wanting to nap in a Cat's Tail cat sofa, was scratched by "the black cat and his minions". Diona smoothed things over so he could use one after dark. Paimon says she likes helping people underneath it all; Kaeya says it is because Durin won't touch alcohol, which makes them two peas in a pod. Diona, listening from a balcony, sniffed. When Kaeya later offered the Traveler a celebratory drink, she cut in: "Absolutely not! No booze allowed!"

19.content: In the limited-time 6.4 Homeward event, the witch Alice built a copy of the Cat's Tail inside her memory bubble and asked Diona to run it. Diona saw it as a perfect chance to switch to super weird ingredients. The cats refused to come, being sensitive to places that only look right, so Alice found Natlan's little saurians as staff instead; Bennett taught Diona how to handle them, and Paimon suggested renaming it "The Saurian's Tail".
